card.name: Tens digit 5 in clock minutes
card.fires_on: The digit 5 that begins the minutes (50s) in a clock time such as 11:55 or 05:54, mostly in web post timestamps.

modes.label: Minutes in post timestamps
modes.description: The 5 right after the colon in a forum or blog time stamp.
modes.example: February 7th, 2011 05:<<5>>6 PM ET Using marijuana, or

modes.label: Minutes in log or file times
modes.description: The 5 after the colon in system, email or file listing times.
modes.example: -14 TMPFILE(3) Generated by dwww version 1.11.3 on Fri May 24 17:<<5>>6:25 CEST 2

card.plain: It lights up on the first digit of the minutes when the minutes are in the 50s, as in 11:55 on a web comment time.
